name: Tetris Live
description: Real Tetris, played live by an AI on the watch, in the classic seven colours: pieces fall, rotate and lock, full rows dissolve and the stack drops. The time is spelled in coloured blocks.

steps.script: const n = project.elements.length; ['Hour','Colon','Minute'].forEach((nm,i)=>{ project.elements[n-3+i].name = nm + ' Aod'; }); return 1
